_README: Every test in UDA's kind-auth contract suite (tests/test-source-auth.js) that the ROW judge is
expected to disagree with, and why. Regenerate the NAMES with:
but never regenerate the REASONS mechanically — an entry without a reason someone wrote is
the whole thing this fixture exists to prevent.
CURRENTLY EMPTY: as of 2026-10-29 the row judge agrees with kind auth on all 50 cases.
That is not the same as 'row auth equals kind auth'. Two differences exist and this suite
1. THE CLAMP. mergeAuth rule 3 stops a SOURCE widening what its patterns gave a principal;
kind auth's mergeAuthPermissions is a per-principal override with no ceiling. Pinned in
2. STRICT DEFAULTS. An unstated chain refuses writes where kind auth's lenient rule opens
them. The datasets side of prod is 100% unstated, so this bites at the flip, not here.
A NEW name appearing in this run is a finding: add it WITH A REASON, or fix the judge.

2026-11-02: `no-pattern-lending` is the first entry here that is OUR decision rather than a divergence to investigate. It is pinned because the reason is written down and measured, not because it is harmless.

reasons.no-pattern-lending: DECIDED, not discovered (owner, 2026-11-02; planning/tasks/current/row-auth-uda-unify-api.md Phase 2). A datasets PATTERN is not a source's ancestor — a source's type is `{env}|{name}:source` and the pattern is nowhere in the path — so its grants no longer reach sources. Kind auth still lends them, via `getSiteSources` reverse-looking-up `pattern.dmsEnvId`, so a request kind auth considers granted is refused by the row judge and `log` writes the would-deny line this case asserts does not appear. The verdict difference is the intended one; the log line is how it shows up here. Measured consequence on prod: 76 internal `:source` rows, 100% unstated, lose the only grants they had — which is why the grant sweep in row-auth-uda.md is a prerequisite of enforcing, not a follow-up. On `rowauth-test` the delta is ZERO: `--audit-writes` reports 163 of 10933 rows admin-only both before and after the change, because nothing there was inheriting anything.
